items.Sentence: The preliminary treatment system consists of four chopper pumps, an odor control system, one channel auger, one grit vortex inducer, two grit pumps, and two grit classifiers.
The preliminary treatment system consists of four chopper pumps, an odor control system, one channel auger, one grit vortex inducer, two grit pumps, and two grit classifiers.
Wastewater from the preliminary treatment system gravity flows to one or more of the five extended aeration units for primary and secondary treatment.

Effluent from the extended aeration units then gravity flows to the secondary clarifiers and then either through the cloth filter to the evaporation/percolation ponds or directly to the evaporation/percolation ponds for disposal.

Effluent from the extended aeration units then gravity flows to the secondary clarifiers and then either through the cloth filter to the evaporation/percolation ponds or directly to the evaporation/percolation ponds for disposal.
Primary and secondary treatment units consist of five extended aeration units, five secondary clarifiers, one cloth filter, and eight evaporation/percolation ponds.
Scum and sludge from the five secondary clarifiers are pumped to a 2.0-meter skid mounted belt filter press.
For emergency operation only, eleven asphalt bottom sludge drying beds are also available for service.

The scum, sludge, grit, and screenings are loaded into trailers daily and hauled offsite by a private contractor. The trailers are hauled offsite for advanced treatment including lime stabilization and “Class A” standards.
